title: Simple Enchantments Extra Pack│簡單的附魔擴充包
description: Extra pack of Simple Enchantments.│Simple Enchantments的擴充包。
body:
# Function│功能
- Make [Simple Enchantments](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/simple-enchantments) compatible with [Vanilla Enchantment Tweak](https://modrinth.com/datapack/vanilla-enchantment-tweak).│使[Simple Enchantments](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/simple-enchantments)與[香草附魔調整](https://modrinth.com/datapack/vanilla-enchantment-tweak)兼容。
- Textures have been added to the Lunge enchanted book.│為突刺附魔書添加了紋理。
